npc.text: Welcome, traveler. The road has been busy today.
Take care when you leave the safety of the city walls.
Adventurers come through here with the strangest stories.
The guild has been receiving requests for supplies all morning.
If you are traveling far, make sure you have what you need.
Visitors often underestimate how quickly the weather can change.
Please keep the main road clear for merchants and chocobos.
I have lived here many years, and there is always something new to see.
Some travelers hurry past without ever looking up at the rooftops.
May your journey bring you safely home.
Please check the guild's posted hours before returning tomorrow.
Materials are not always available in the quantities you expect.
A careful craftsperson wastes very little.
Do not rush the synthesis. Preparation matters.
If you are learning, start with a recipe suited to your current skill.
We appreciate customers who know exactly what they need.
Guild members have been busy with orders this week.
Keep your tools in good condition. It saves trouble later.
Stay alert beyond the gates. Not every traveler is friendly.
Report unusual activity to the guard stationed at the next post.
Keep the road clear and do not obstruct the gate.
Those heading into dangerous territory should travel prepared.
The patrol has already passed. The road is clear for now.
Please do not mistake a quiet road for a safe one.
We do what we can to keep the city peaceful.
The market has been lively since the merchants arrived.
Travelers have been asking for directions all morning.
I hope the rain clears before the next caravan departs.
Please mind the steps. They can be slippery after a shower.
An adventurer left a parcel here. I hope they remember where they put it.
The city sounds different when the airship has just arrived.
We have had visitors from all three nations this week.
Take a moment to rest before setting out again.
The guild workers have been busy since sunrise.
Somewhere nearby, someone is always looking for a missing chocobo.
Please keep your weapons secured while inside the shop.
I have heard plenty of stories from the road, though I suspect some are exaggerated.
The guards have been changing shifts. The gate should be clear soon.
Merchants prefer customers who know what they came to buy.
I hope you find what you are looking for today.
Keep to the path if you are unfamiliar with this region.
The wind has been strong across the open ground today.
Travelers often underestimate the distance between safe places.
Do not follow strange lights into the brush after dark.
If you hear a monster nearby, give it room and keep moving.
Some gatherers come here before dawn to avoid the crowds.
Please do not leave your rubbish along the road.
The weather can turn quickly beyond the hills.
I have seen many adventurers pass through, but few stop to enjoy the view.
Take care near the cliffs. The ground is not as steady as it looks.
That path is longer, but it is easier to follow.
Wait for your companions before crossing the open field.
The local wildlife is best admired from a safe distance.
Keep your map close. The landmarks can look alike from here.
May the road be kind to you.
You have been coming through here often. I hope the road has been kind to you.
The guild workers speak well of adventurers who treat them courteously.
I hope you and your friends have a safe journey.
People remember those who lend a hand when the road gets difficult.
Welcome back. It is good to see familiar travelers return safely.
